title: TMDB
intro: nexcrate finds movies and series through The Movie Database, TMDB for short: title, year, poster, seasons and episodes. You need your own access for it, free for private use.
needed: To search, nexcrate needs your own access to TMDB. It is free for personal use.
missing: No token stored yet. Without it nexcrate cannot find, add or refresh movies and series.

guide.title: How to get the token
guide.login: Log in at themoviedb.org. An account is free.
guide.settingsLink: Open the API settings at TMDB
guide.copy: Copy the “API Read Access Token”, not the “API Key”.
guide.paste: Paste it below, then test and save.

tokenHint: The long token. It usually starts with eyJ.
replaceHint: A token is saved. Paste a new one here to replace it.
saved: The token works and is saved.
looksLikeKey: This looks like the API Key. nexcrate needs the longer API Read Access Token.
removeText: Without a token nexcrate no longer searches for movies, and cached search results are deleted. Your library stays as it is.
